limitations: This checks known Go advisories against the current repository snapshot observed at HEAD, with generated database modified 2026-11-05T23:49:57Z. It does not assert that the inaccessible live deployed API has identical state or cover undisclosed vulnerabilities.
Source native scope is ./... without tests. WASM source scopes cover client/mutation/offline/navigation/routing/UI and demo components, in core and nextgo_module configurations.
Binary scans cover actual source-independent demo/root ELF executables; they do not analyze embedded WASM bytes.
A symbol finding is a reachability or linked-symbol signal from the checker, not an independently confirmed exploit.
The Codex Security source-audit workflow still lacks ready preflight/supporting assets/context. No current source audit, canonical report or production security approval follows.
Real cloud/CDN/proxy deployment, broader browser engines, performance budgets and remaining 79-capability/11-gate requirements remain open.
productionPolicy: Existing production Docker image is already pinned to Go 1.27.3. Go 1.24 is the language/compatibility floor and is already documented as unsupported for production; its compatibility passes do not waive these advisory results.
